description: Output contract for one audit run (PROJECT_BOOK §6.3). The report carries the audit status, coverage, findings and the three run hashes. Hash fields are null until a real run fills them — the spec file never carries fabricated hashes. Reports are written through src/privacy `redactReport` before sharing, so no absolute path or credential value appears here.

audit_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the whole audit report; null until a real run.

expected_count.description: Instances the policy expects the bot to load.

findings.description: Findings in the frozen §5.2 taxonomy (ReportV1 carries the summary fields only).

inventory_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the observed inventory; null until a real run.

observed_count.description: Instances actually observed; null when the audit could not enumerate (INCOMPLETE).

oracle_result_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the Oracle result for this run; null until a real run.

schema.description: Contract version. Any other value is an unknown report version.

title: SkillScope audit report (v1)
